The '''Kobaria system''' was located in the [[Emmo sector/Legends|Emmo sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[Kobarian swamp dog]]s.<ref name="Hondo" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kobaria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-12.<ref name="TEA" />
